finite_diagnostics.logical_role: Finite adversarial diagnostics only, not the proof of the universal quantifiers.
finite_diagnostics.model: Original reduced free product C[F_2] * C[T], T uniform on [-1,1]
finite_diagnostics.postcondition: Every tested derivative trace is exactly zero; two independent derivations and moment recursions agree.

formal_evidence.coverage: Arbitrary noncommutative ring, every finite word and position selection; all positive iterates; all natural-number Taylor growth parameters.
formal_evidence.not_formalized: Freeness, reduced-centered-word spanning, operator-algebra realization, ODE existence and analytic continuation are proved in REPORT.md, not in Lean.

jacobian.logical_role: Auxiliary linear coefficient check for the two-factor telescoping step; no noncommutative freeness claim is delegated to a commutative operation.

normalization: For a monomial of z-degree m, the manuscript derivative trace is i^r*pi^(m+r) times the normalized real-derivation trace. Extend by finite linearity.

proof.mechanism: Group-label reduction, initial conjugate freeness, complementary inner-commutator insertion cancellation, positive iteration, and a time-uniform Taylor bound.

quantifiers.coefficients: Every finite tuple of finitely supported real h_j on F_n
quantifiers.polynomial: Every finite complex formal star polynomial, with no degree bound
quantifiers.time: Every real t for the actual global unitary solution
